gaps.title: Reconcile public GA vocabulary with release artifacts
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Buyers can read 'GA-tier core' while the site says source evaluation and no immutable server release exists; production commitments are therefore unauditable.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Treat every audited row as evaluation/prerelease and use the generated matrix rather than inferring GA from Implemented, supported, covered, or stable.
exitEvidence: One authoritative vocabulary maps producer statuses to GA without implication.
The release gate rejects public GA keys outside the evidenced-GA set.
Site and server claims derive from the passed decision.

gaps.title: Pin immutable server image, commit, and evidence lineage
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Customers cannot reproduce or roll back a candidate when tests are not tied to an image digest and commit.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Run trunk/nightly images as evaluation-only and record commits manually.
exitEvidence: Candidate image digest resolves to the audited server commit.
Conformance, security, limits/errors, performance, and observability receipts name that digest.
A rollback drill restores the previous digest.

gaps.title: Add capability canaries, reset, rollback, and incident ownership
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Fixtures do not show that the deployed candidate serves the claim or can safely recover/reset.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Probe read-only routes manually and avoid stateful demonstrations.
exitEvidence: Scheduled canaries record image digest and semantic assertions.
Reset runs record before/after state digests.
Rollback drill and incident owner are attached.

gaps.title: Admit fixture and live semantic receipts for every GA job
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Gallery/source success cannot establish the exact release job result across documented platforms.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use fixture samples and retained external First Map/COG envelopes as evaluation evidence only.
exitEvidence: Each job has digest-pinned fixture and Honua-candidate live receipts with TTL.
Receipts assert geospatial semantics, not only status/UI shape.
Browser/platform and accessibility artifacts are admitted where claimed.

gaps.title: Close bounded COG hardening and object-locality proof
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Direct cloud raster serving is unsafe for GA while malicious TIFF, decompression-bound, and locality hardening remains open.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use reviewed bounded COGs and client transfer ceilings; reject untrusted raster inputs.
exitEvidence: Adversarial COG suite passes on the candidate.
Range/decoded-byte/time ceilings fail closed with stable errors.
Live proof records object locality and bounded windows.

gaps.title: Publish exact cross-SDK surfaces and version window
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: JS is beta while Python/.NET are source previews; source coverage is not a supported multi-language rollout.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Pin source commits and use only dossier symbols; do not infer parity from labels.
exitEvidence: Published package versions exist or lanes are explicitly excluded.
Server/SDK compatibility and deprecation windows are public.
Cross-language semantic fixtures prove claimed parity.

gaps.title: Publish raster/coverage limits, performance, and offload behavior
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Functionally correct coverage APIs remain operationally unsafe without budgets, streaming limits, and a durable-job boundary.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use bounded subsets, cached tiles, and external byte/time ceilings.
exitEvidence: Enforced request/memory/response ceilings are public.
Candidate benchmarks cover COG/Coverages/WCS subsets.
Excessive work has deterministic error or durable-job behavior.

gaps.title: Finish PMTiles managed lifecycle and live proxy proof
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Static reads work, but archive/publish lifecycle and cleanup are not a supported trunk SDK surface.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use static PMTiles and the demo proxy; manage retention outside the SDK.
exitEvidence: Published lifecycle symbols match archive/publish/status/cancel without claiming register/delete.
A Maui proxy canary proves HEAD and bounded Range GET.
Retention/overwrite cleanup is documented and tested.

gaps.title: Define GeoParquet/GeoArrow server-output semantic parity
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: The JS runtime is strong, but canonical keying and cross-SDK output semantics do not support GA interoperability.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use beta client-only GeoParquet and inspect server output manually.
exitEvidence: Canonical keys separate client-only and server-output claims.
Goldens cover CRS, geometry, nulls, dictionaries, and int64.
A tracked issue owns remaining parity work.

gaps.title: Normalize OGC process lifecycle semantics across SDKs
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Users cannot rely on one job lifecycle when .NET lacks a bounded waiter, Python is source preview, CLI is absent, and server DELETE is best-effort cancellation.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use JS bounded wait, implement an application loop in .NET, and call Python source APIs only in evaluation environments.
exitEvidence: One cross-SDK job fixture asserts submit/poll/results/cancel semantics.
.NET has a bounded wait helper or a documented intentional exclusion.
CLI lifecycle absence is explicitly supported or filled.

gaps.title: Keep Zarr, NetCDF, and HDF5 outside GA
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: Premature GA would imply production slicing/security/performance not established by source implementation and partial metadata coverage.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use preview-only bounded reviewed datasets; use WCS GeoTIFF/PNG/JPEG for the GA candidate.
exitEvidence: Format-specific bounded/security/performance suites pass.
A deployed preview canary proves bounded slices.
Promotion requires a new dossier decision.

gaps.title: Keep cloud custom-code authoring and execution out of GA
gaps.userCompetitiveImpact: The AWS Batch server contract exists, but Studio author/publish UX, SDK wrappers, resources/retries/idempotency, bindings, log streaming, cleanup, and live proof do not.
gaps.currentWorkaround: Use the server contract/design and source fixtures only; do not advertise an executable Studio walkthrough.
exitEvidence: Studio author/publish UX and sanctioned SDK submission wrapper exist.
CPU/memory/retry/idempotency/log/TTL contracts are enforced and evidenced.
A live demo proves safe submission, output, logs, and cleanup.
